turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

Happy to help with that! Please tell me your idea, the size, the placement on your body and when you are available. I will pass everything to a colleague, who will take over from there. I cannot give a price or a date myself.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you! I passed your idea (a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, outside of the left forearm, weekday evenings) to a colleague, who will take over. I cannot promise a price, a date or a reservation.
